```{r}
#| label: setup
#| cache: false
#| include: false

library(quanteda)
library(quanteda.textstats)
library(quanteda.textmodels)
library(quanteda.textplots)
library(tidyverse)

# Locate the saved corpus relative to this document or an ancestor folder.
input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
input_dir <- if (nzchar(input_file) && file.exists(input_file)) {
  dirname(normalizePath(input_file, winslash = "/"))
} else {
  normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/")
}
project_dir <- input_dir
repeat {
  candidate <- file.path(project_dir, "data/assign06_private/cpd_corpus.rds")
  if (file.exists(candidate)) break
  parent <- dirname(project_dir)
  if (identical(parent, project_dir)) {
    stop(paste(
      "Saved CPD corpus not found. Put this QMD in your original course project,",
      "where data/assign06_private/cpd_corpus.rds was saved."
    ))
  }
  project_dir <- parent
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
private_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "data/assign06_private")
output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "outputs/assign06")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Fail early if the saved corpus is unavailable or lacks administration labels.
cpd_corpus <- readRDS(candidate)
if (!inherits(cpd_corpus, "corpus")) stop("The saved object is not a quanteda corpus.")
admin_labels <- docvars(cpd_corpus, "administration")
if (length(admin_labels) != ndoc(cpd_corpus) || anyNA(admin_labels) ||
    !setequal(as.character(admin_labels), c("Biden", "Trump"))) {
  stop("The saved CPD corpus must contain verified Biden and Trump labels.")
}

# Download the archived tweet CSV only if it is not already saved locally.
tweet_file <- file.path(private_dir, "summit_11162021.csv")
if (!file.exists(tweet_file)) {
  tweet_temp <- tempfile(tmpdir = private_dir, fileext = ".csv")
  download_status <- download.file(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datageneration/datamethods/master/textanalytics/summit_11162021.csv",
    tweet_temp, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE
  )
  if (download_status != 0) stop("The archived tweet download failed.")
  tweet_check <- readr::read_csv(tweet_temp, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (!"text" %in% names(tweet_check)) stop("The tweet archive has no text column.")
  if (!file.rename(tweet_temp, tweet_file)) stop("Could not save the tweet archive.")
}

# Invalidate the analysis caches if source data or relevant package versions change.
cache_packages <- c("quanteda", "quanteda.textstats", "quanteda.textmodels",
                    "quanteda.textplots", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "knitr")
cache_signature <- list(
  files = tools::md5sum(c(candidate, tweet_file)),
  packages = vapply(cache_packages, function(p) as.character(packageVersion(p)),
                    character(1)),
  R = as.character(getRversion())
)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  cache.path = paste0(file.path(private_dir, "assignment6_render_cache"), "/"),
  cache.extra = cache_signature,
  fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6
)
set.seed(6302)
```

## 2(a)(i). Archived summit tweets

```{r}
#| label: tweet-data
#| cache: true

# Read the local archive; preserve the professor's object names.
summit <- read_csv(tweet_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
sum_twt <- summit$text

tweet_audit <- tibble(
  archived_rows = nrow(summit),
  missing_or_blank = sum(is.na(sum_twt) | trimws(sum_twt) == "")
)
sum_twt <- sum_twt[!is.na(sum_twt) & trimws(sum_twt) != ""]
tweet_audit$retained_rows <- length(sum_twt)
tweet_audit$repeated_text <- sum(duplicated(sum_twt))
knitr::kable(tweet_audit, caption = "Tweet archive checks; repeated text is retained")
sum_corpus <- corpus(sum_twt)
toks <- tokens(sum_twt)
sumtwtdfm <- dfm(toks)
```

### Frequent words

```{r}
#| label: tweet-frequency
#| cache: true
#| dependson: tweet-data

# Frequent words

# Counts content words after removing common stopwords and other material. Hashtags and mentions are excluded here because we analyze them separately next.

toks_words <- tokens(
  sum_twt,
  remove_punct = TRUE,
  remove_numbers = TRUE,
  remove_url = TRUE
)

toks_words <- tokens_tolower(toks_words)

toks_words <- tokens_remove(
  toks_words,
  pattern = c(stopwords("en"), "rt", "#*", "@*"),
  valuetype = "glob"
)

word_dfm <- dfm(toks_words)

# Display the 20 most frequent words


# Frequency table
word_frequency <- textstat_frequency(word_dfm, n = 20)

knitr::kable(word_frequency, caption = "Most frequent content words")

# Plot
ggplot(
  word_frequency,
  aes(x = reorder(feature, frequency), y = frequency)
) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Frequent Words in Summit Tweets",
    x = "Word",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

### Hashtag network

```{r}
#| label: tweet-hashtag-network
#| cache: true
#| dependson: tweet-frequency

set.seed(6302)
tweet_dfm <- tokens(sum_twt, remove_punct = TRUE) %>%
  dfm()



tag_dfm <- dfm_select(tweet_dfm, pattern = "#*")

toptag <- names(topfeatures(tag_dfm, 50))

head(toptag, 10)

tag_fcm <- fcm(tag_dfm)



topgat_fcm <- fcm_select(tag_fcm, pattern = toptag)

textplot_network(
  topgat_fcm,
  min_freq = 50,
  edge_alpha = 0.8,
  edge_size = 1
)
```


### Speech length

```{r}
#| label: inaugural-length
#| cache: true
#| dependson: inaugural-corpus

# Speech Length

# Tokens for length and lexical diversity
# Retain stopwords for these measures

inaug_toks <- tokens(
  inaug_corpus,
  remove_punct = TRUE,
  remove_numbers = TRUE,
  remove_symbols = TRUE
)

inaug_toks <- tokens_tolower(inaug_toks)

inaug_stats <- tibble(
  document = docnames(inaug_corpus),
  Year = docvars(inaug_corpus, "Year"),
  President = docvars(inaug_corpus, "President"),
  Party = docvars(inaug_corpus, "Party"),
  words = as.numeric(ntoken(inaug_toks))
)

knitr::kable(inaug_stats)

ggplot(inaug_stats, aes(x = Year, y = words)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = Party), size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Length of Inaugural Addresses",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Word Tokens"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

### Cosine similarity

```{r}
#| label: inaugural-similarity
#| cache: true
#| dependson: inaugural-readability
#| fig-height: 9

# Cosine Similarity
# Content-word DFM for similarity and keyness

inaug_content <- tokens_remove(
  inaug_toks,
  pattern = stopwords("en")
)

inaug_dfm <- dfm(inaug_content)

# Cosine similarity
inaug_similarity <- textstat_simil(
  inaug_dfm,
  method = "cosine",
  margin = "documents"
)

similarity_matrix <- as.matrix(inaug_similarity)

# Heatmap
heatmap(
  similarity_matrix,
  Rowv = NA,
  Colv = NA,
  scale = "none",
  margins = c(9, 9)
)

# Most similar distinct speech pairs
pair_index <- which(
  upper.tri(similarity_matrix),
  arr.ind = TRUE
)

similarity_pairs <- tibble(
  speech1 = rownames(similarity_matrix)[pair_index[, 1]],
  speech2 = colnames(similarity_matrix)[pair_index[, 2]],
  similarity = similarity_matrix[pair_index]
) %>%
  arrange(desc(similarity))

head(similarity_pairs, 10)
```

## 3. Wordfish

### Model preparation and orientation

```{r}
#| label: wordfish-preparation
#| cache: true
#| dependson: inaugural-latest

# Retain words occurring in at least two speeches

wordfish_dfm <- dfm_trim(
  inaug_dfm,
  min_docfreq = 2,
  docfreq_type = "count"
)

# Compare feature counts
nfeat(inaug_dfm)
nfeat(wordfish_dfm)

# Confirm that no document has become empty
stopifnot(
  all(ntoken(wordfish_dfm) > 0)
)






# Identify the earliest and latest speeches

speech_years <- docvars(wordfish_dfm, "Year")

first_document <- which.min(speech_years)
last_document <- which.max(speech_years)

# Inspect the two documents used to orient the scale
docnames(wordfish_dfm)[
  c(first_document, last_document)
]
```

### Model estimation

```{r}
#| label: wordfish-model
#| cache: true
#| dependson: wordfish-preparation

inaug_wordfish <- textmodel_wordfish(
  wordfish_dfm,
  dir = c(first_document, last_document)
)

# Examine model output
summary(inaug_wordfish)
```

<!-- Original collection and PDF preparation preserved for reference only. -->

```{r}
#| label: collection-reference-do-not-run
#| cache: false
#| include: false
#| eval: false

# Search GovInfo
# Search GovInfo for CPD documents mentioning Xi Jinping

govinfo_key <- Sys.getenv("GOVINFO_API_KEY")

if (!nzchar(govinfo_key)) {
  stop("GOVINFO_API_KEY was not found.")
}

end_date <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")

query <- paste0(
  'collection:cpd "Xi Jinping" ',
  'publishdate:range(2021-01-20,', end_date, ')'
)

offset <- "*"
seen_offsets <- character()
govfiles3 <- tibble()
search_log <- tibble()

repeat {

  if (offset %in% seen_offsets) {
    stop("Repeated cursor: the search is incomplete.")
  }

  seen_offsets <- c(seen_offsets, offset)

  response <- request("https://api.govinfo.gov/search") %>%
    req_headers(`X-Api-Key` = govinfo_key) %>%
    req_body_json(list(
      query = query,
      pageSize = 100L,
      offsetMark = offset,
      sorts = list(list(
        field = "publishdate",
        sortOrder = "ASC"
      ))
    )) %>%
    req_retry(max_tries = 4) %>%
    req_timeout(90) %>%
    req_perform() %>%
    resp_body_json(simplifyVector = FALSE)
  
  # Extract one row per document
# Keep only the fields needed for the following blocks

page <- purrr::map_dfr(response$results, function(document) {

  if (length(document$packageId) != 1L) {
    stop("A search result has a missing or unexpected packageId.")
  }

  tibble(
    packageId = as.character(document$packageId),
    title = if (length(document$title) == 0L) {
      NA_character_
    } else {
      paste(unlist(document$title), collapse = "; ")
    }
  )

})

  if (is.null(response$count)) {
    stop("Unexpected API response: missing result count.")
  }

  total_matches <- as.integer(response$count)

  search_log <- bind_rows(
    search_log,
    tibble(
      page = nrow(search_log) + 1L,
      records = nrow(page),
      reported_total = total_matches
    )
  )

  if (nrow(page) == 0) {
    stop("No results on this page. Check query and pagination.")
  }

  govfiles3 <- bind_rows(govfiles3, page) %>%
    distinct(packageId, .keep_all = TRUE)

  if (nrow(govfiles3) >= total_matches) break

  next_offset <- response$offsetMark

  if (is.null(next_offset)) {
    next_offset <- response$nextOffsetMark
  }

  if (is.null(next_offset)) {
    stop("Missing next cursor: collection is incomplete.")
  }

  offset <- as.character(next_offset)

  Sys.sleep(0.3)
}

stopifnot(nrow(govfiles3) == total_matches)

# Check completeness
nrow(govfiles3)
total_matches

# Save search records without the key
write_csv(
  search_log,
  "outputs/assign06/cpd_search_log.csv"
)

writeLines(
  c(
    paste("Query:", query),
    paste("Collection date:", Sys.Date()),
    "Date filter: publication date.",
    paste("Unique matches:", nrow(govfiles3))
  ),
  "outputs/assign06/cpd_collection_note.txt"
)

saveRDS(
  govfiles3,
  "data/assign06_private/cpd_search_results.rds"
)



# Prepare PDF links

# Preparing for bulk download of government documents
pdf_govfiles_id <- govfiles3$packageId

pdf_govfiles_url <- paste0(
  "https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/",
  pdf_govfiles_id,
  "/pdf/",
  pdf_govfiles_id,
  ".pdf"
)

save_dir <- "data/assign06_private/cpd"

dir.create(
  save_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)



# Download PDFs --> Investigate any failed downloads. Having found every document is # different from successfully downloading every document.

# Function to download PDFs
download_govfiles_pdf <- function(url, id) {

  tryCatch({

    destfile <- file.path(
      save_dir,
      paste0("govfiles_", id, ".pdf")
    )

    status <- download.file(
      url,
      destfile = destfile,
      mode = "wb",
      quiet = TRUE
    )

    if (status != 0) stop("Download failed")

    Sys.sleep(runif(1, 1, 3))

    return("downloaded")

  }, error = function(e) {

    return("failed")

  })
}

# Download all matching documents

start.time <- Sys.time()

message("Starting downloads")

results <- seq_along(pdf_govfiles_url) %>%
  map_chr(
    ~ download_govfiles_pdf(
      pdf_govfiles_url[.],
      pdf_govfiles_id[.]
    )
  )

message("Finished downloads")

end.time <- Sys.time()
time.taken <- end.time - start.time

time.taken
table(results)


# Create the manifest

# Document manifest
cpd_manifest <- tibble(
  document = pdf_govfiles_id,
  title = govfiles3$title,
  source_url = paste0(
    "https://www.govinfo.gov/app/details/",
    pdf_govfiles_id
  ),
  download_status = results,
  administration = NA_character_,
  verified = FALSE
)

write_csv(
  cpd_manifest,
  "outputs/assign06/cpd_manifest_to_review.csv"
)




# Automatically identify the president using GovInfo metadata

library(xml2)
library(httr2)
library(tidyverse)

# Read the manifest created in Block 12
cpd_manifest <- read_csv(
  "outputs/assign06/cpd_manifest_to_review.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Folder for metadata files
metadata_dir <- "data/assign06_private/cpd_metadata"

dir.create(
  metadata_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Function to identify the president
get_president <- function(id) {

  metadata_url <- paste0(
    "https://www.govinfo.gov/metadata/pkg/",
    id,
    "/mods.xml"
  )

  metadata_file <- file.path(
    metadata_dir,
    paste0(id, ".xml")
  )

  tryCatch({

    # Reuse metadata already downloaded
    if (file.exists(metadata_file)) {

      metadata <- read_xml(metadata_file)

    } else {

      response <- request(metadata_url) %>%
        req_retry(max_tries = 3) %>%
        req_timeout(60) %>%
        req_perform()

      metadata <- read_xml(resp_body_raw(response))

      # Check that the response is a MODS metadata record
      root_name <- xml_find_chr(
        metadata,
        "local-name(/*)"
      )

      if (root_name != "mods") {
        stop("Unexpected metadata format.")
      }

      write_xml(metadata, metadata_file)

      Sys.sleep(0.3)
    }

    # Read names ONLY within the dedicated president field
    president_names <- xml_find_all(
      metadata,
      "//*[local-name()='president']/*[local-name()='name']"
    ) %>%
      xml_text() %>%
      str_squish()

    president_names <- unique(
      president_names[nzchar(president_names)]
    )

    president_text <- paste(
      president_names,
      collapse = "; "
    )

    is_biden <- str_detect(
      president_text,
      regex("\\bBiden\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )

    is_trump <- str_detect(
      president_text,
      regex("\\bTrump\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )

    administration <- case_when(
      is_biden & !is_trump ~ "Biden",
      is_trump & !is_biden ~ "Trump",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )

    tibble(
      president_metadata = president_text,
      administration = administration,
      verified = !is.na(administration),
      verification_method = "GovInfo president metadata",
      metadata_status = ifelse(
        is.na(administration),
        "needs_check",
        "matched"
      )
    )

  }, error = function(e) {

    tibble(
      president_metadata = NA_character_,
      administration = NA_character_,
      verified = FALSE,
      verification_method = "GovInfo president metadata",
      metadata_status = "retrieval_or_parse_failed"
    )

  })
}

# Identify the president for each document
president_results <- seq_len(nrow(cpd_manifest)) %>%
  map_dfr(function(i) {

    message(
      "Checking document ",
      i,
      " of ",
      nrow(cpd_manifest)
    )

    get_president(cpd_manifest$document[i])
  })

# Replace the blank administration and verification columns
cpd_manifest <- cpd_manifest %>%
  select(-any_of(c("administration", "verified"))) %>%
  bind_cols(president_results)

# Inspect the results
table(
  cpd_manifest$administration,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

table(cpd_manifest$metadata_status)

# Save the file expected by Block 13
write_csv(
  cpd_manifest,
  "outputs/assign06/cpd_manifest_reviewed.csv"
)

# Save only unresolved cases separately
unresolved <- cpd_manifest %>%
  filter(!verified)

write_csv(
  unresolved,
  "outputs/assign06/cpd_metadata_unresolved.csv"
)

# Check whether you can proceed
if (nrow(unresolved) == 0 &&
    all(cpd_manifest$download_status == "downloaded")) {

  message(
    "All administrations identified and downloads recorded ",
    "as successful. Proceed to Block 13."
  )

} else {

  message(
    "Some records need attention. Check the tables below ",
    "before proceeding to Block 13."
  )

  print(
    unresolved %>%
      select(document, title, metadata_status, source_url)
  )

  print(
    cpd_manifest %>%
      filter(download_status != "downloaded") %>%
      select(document, download_status)
  )
}
```
